_comment: One file per class. All classes share the studio05 base body; a class is an animation set plus how our moves map onto its clips. 'animations' is the GLB the clips are read from (same 102-joint rig as the body files), 'clip_marks' its timing marks. weapon_visible/weapon_scale/off_hand: what the hands hold for the look (the combat 'weapon' id keeps owning the stats). Advance (travel) distances live in the weapon's overrides in data/combat/weapons.json.
_weapon_families: Weapon items (catalog weapon_type) this class card may wear in its weapon slot, logic/profile.gd card_can_wear (Boss 2026-11-11). Starter weapon: catalog starter_longbow (design/gdd/race-gear-sets.md 3.2).
_idle_variants: Idle clips the card portraits (hub cards, character screen) cycle through: mostly states.idle, now and then another one (client/card_portrait.gd). Display only; battle fighters keep states.idle.
_hair_options: Studio 2026-11-11 index.html hair buttons A, B, C, E, F, G (offered for every class) + hair I (Boss 2026-11-13); G = hair/hair_g.glb, I = hair/hair_i.glb. Each is a hair-only file (art/characters/studio05/split/manifest.json) merged onto the class body.
_pilot: GDD races-and-classes 3.2 pilot profile, read by logic/auto_pilot.gd for squad cards (a class without it keeps the old constants). target: nearest|peel|densest|lowest_hp|marked_first. engage_range 0 = from the weapon; shoot_range 0 = the default 6 m. prefer_marked: attack a target carrying mark_status inside the engage range first (Hunter's Mark focus fire). line is not used yet.
_signature: GDD races-and-classes 3.2 class signature (any race). Hunter's Mark: the first hit on a new target applies sunder (DEF -40%); the other cards' pilots prefer that marked target (pilot.prefer_marked).
_gauge: GDD races-and-classes 3.10.2: this class's multipliers on the shared race gauge rule (data/races/rules.json gauge, formula 4.7), read by logic/race_passives.gd.
_skill_tree: Class branch of the card skill tree (design/gdd/skill-tree.md 3.1, 3.8): 16 nodes T1..T4, validated by logic/skill_tree_data.gd against data/skill_tree/rules.json. excl = OR pair id. Numbers are placeholders.

nodes.name: Marked Line
nodes.text: Heartseeker pierces, and every enemy it passes through gets Hunter's Mark (`sunder`).

nodes.name: Light Feet
nodes.text: Vault Shot distance 4 -> 5 m and `slow` 3 -> 4 s.

nodes.name: Hunter's Rhythm
nodes.text: Rapid Fire 4 -> 5 arrows. Arrows retarget to marked enemies first.

nodes.name: Split Volley
nodes.text: +2 arrows in a +-15 degree cone, dmg x0.7.

nodes.name: Smoke Vault
nodes.text: the take-off spot leaves a 2 s `slow` cloud r2 m (one-shot apply).

nodes.name: Parting Shot
nodes.text: the landing shot applies `bleed`, dmg x1.2.

nodes.name: Through Pin
nodes.text: Pinning Shot pierces +2 and pins each target hit, dmg x0.9.

nodes.name: Spread Fire
nodes.text: arrows alternate between the target and the next nearest enemy, dmg x0.85.

nodes.name: Deep Mark
nodes.text: Hunter's Mark lasts +3 s and also applies `weaken`.

nodes.name: Pack Hunt
nodes.text: Allies deal +10% damage to marked targets (the squad focus-fires harder).

nodes.name: Deadeye
nodes.text: Every 4th basic shot on a marked target is a forced crit that also pierces.

nodes.name: Skirmisher
nodes.text: `kite_distance` 3 → 5 m and dodge cooldown ×0.6. After each dodge, the next skill casts instantly (cast time 0).
